nameOrigin: young feeding stage of an insect

pokedexEntries.ru: To make prey faint, VIBRAVA generates ultrasonic waves by vigorously making its two wings vibrate. This POKéMON’s ultrasonic waves are so powerful, they can bring on headaches in people.

pokedexEntries.sa: VIBRAVA’s wings have not yet completed the process of growing. Rather than flying long distances, they are more useful for generating ultrasonic waves by vibrating.

pokedexEntries.frlg: It generates ultrasonic waves by violently flapping its wings. After making its prey faint, it melts the prey with acid.

pokedexEntries.em: It looses ultrasonic waves by rubbing its wings together. Since a VIBRAVA’s wings are still in the process of growing, it can only fly short distances.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It vibrates its wings vigorously, creating ultrasonic waves that cause serious headaches.

pokedexEntries.bw: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

pokedexEntries.x: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

pokedexEntries.y: It generates ultrasonic waves by violently flapping its wings. After making its prey faint, it melts the prey with acid.

pokedexEntries.or: To make prey faint, Vibrava generates ultrasonic waves by vigorously making its two wings vibrate. This Pokémon’s ultrasonic waves are so powerful, they can bring on headaches in people.

pokedexEntries.as: Vibrava’s wings have not yet completed the process of growing. Rather than flying long distances, they are more useful for generating ultrasonic waves by vibrating.

pokedexEntries.su: Rather than using its underdeveloped wings for flight, it rubs them together, producing ultrasonic waves to attack its enemies.

pokedexEntries.mo: To help make its wings grow, it dissolves quantities of prey in its digestive juices and guzzles them down every day.

pokedexEntries.us: It vibrates its wings to generate ultrasonic waves, causing its prey to faint. Then it buries the prey alive in the sand to preserve it.

pokedexEntries.um: It vibrates its wings to send out odd sound waves. Trainers who are with it need earplugs.

pokedexEntries.sw: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

pokedexEntries.sh: To help make its wings grow, it dissolves quantities of prey in its digestive juices and guzzles them down every day.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.

pokedexEntries.sc: Rather than using its underdeveloped wings for flight, it rubs them together, emitting ultrasonic waves to attack its enemies.

pokedexEntries.vi: It generates ultrasonic waves by vigorously vibrating its wings. After making its prey faint, it dissolves the prey with its digestive juices.
